generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work/Civil work of value not less than Rs.4.23 Lakhs

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26).Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (one similar work) of Rs 16.94 Lakhs
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Tenderers registered in BBMP or equivalent registration of KPWD/CPWD or any state governmental organization for the execution works

Tenderers who meet the specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. Tender available tender capacity will be calculated as under for assessed available tender capacity refer the tender document
For any other conditions refer the tender document
Regardless of any labour related issues that may arise bidder will be the sole responsible person
Bidders shall quote the amount for items excluding GST
The amount put to tender is exclusive of 18% GST for the estimated cost
The rates quoted by contractor against individual items shall be exclusive of GST
This tender is reserved for this SC category only.
